entries.title: Strict binding across every mass split
entries.summary: Strict subadditivity of the constrained energy for every nontrivial split in a stated sufficient mass interval.
entries.limit: Two-dimensional cubic–quintic model with β, γ > 0 and 0 < m ≤ mB, not an all-mass theorem.
entries.statement:
theorem strict_binding (hβ : 0 < β) (hγ : 0 < γ) {m μ : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hmB : m ≤ mB β γ k)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμm : μ < m) :
    Imin β γ k m < Imin β γ k μ + Imin β γ k (m - μ) :=

entries.title: Orbital stability of the minimizing set
entries.summary: A solution that begins near the constrained minimizers remains near their complete orbit in the specified H² setting.
entries.limit: Set stability in the sufficient mass range, not uniqueness or stability of every excited state.
entries.statement:
theorem orbital_stability (hβ : 0 < β) (hγ : 0 < γ) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hmB : m ≤ StrictBinding.mB β γ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ u : ℝ → H2 2, IsSolution β γ k u → distX (u 0) (Gset β γ k m) < δ →
      BddAbove (Set.range fun t => distX (u t) (Gset β γ k m)) ∧
      ⨆ t, distX (u t) (Gset β γ k m) < ε :=

entries.title: Global well-posed nonlinear flow
entries.summary: Existence and uniqueness of global H² evolution in the stipulated two-dimensional cubic–quintic equation.
entries.limit: Model-specific flow, not a general fourth-order PDE existence theorem.
entries.statement:
theorem global_wellposed (hγ : 0 < γ) (u₀ : H2 2) :
    ∃! u : ℝ → H2 2, IsSolution β γ k u ∧ u 0 = u₀ :=

entries.title: Curvature energy has no local minimizer
entries.summary: An explicit spreading direction rules out constrained local minimizers of the positive curvature-energy model.
entries.limit: Applies to the declared positive-coefficient model and dimensions one through four.
entries.statement:
theorem no_local_minimizer (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (hd4 : d ≤ 4) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hα : 0 ≤ α) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) {U : H2 d} (hU : U.M = m) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ V : H2 d, V.M = m ∧ H2.distH2 V U < δ ∧ Ec c₁ c₂ ε α V < Ec c₁ c₂ ε α U :=

entries.title: An exact dimensional estimate boundary
entries.summary: The stated local H¹ gradient estimate is characterized exactly by spatial dimension two.
entries.limit: A classification of one quantified estimate, not all possible confinement mechanisms.
entries.statement: theorem e68L2_iff_two (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : E68L2Holds n ↔ n = 2 :=

entries.title: No nonzero L² field on an isolated Fourier shell
entries.summary: An L² Fourier transform restricted to a measure-zero sphere must represent the zero field.
entries.limit: A whole-space L² exclusion, not a prohibition on approximate bands or generalized eigenfunctions.
entries.statement:
theorem shell_exclusion (d : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (u : L2 (d + 1))
    (h : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂volume, ξ ∉ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) k →
      (equivalence (d + 1) u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) → ℂ) ξ = 0) :
    u = 0 :=

entries.title: Contractive Fourier-multiplier semigroup
entries.summary: The defined time-evolution Fourier multiplier is contractive in the L² norm.
entries.limit: A specified linear semigroup with nonnegative parameters, not an arbitrary nonlinear evolution.
entries.statement:
theorem S_contracts (a kStar t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (f : Sobolev.L2 d) : ‖S a kStar t ha ht f‖ ≤ ‖f‖ :=

entries.title: A 20-dimensional local observation fiber
entries.summary: The fixed nonlinear observation model admits a local fiber of dimension twenty.
entries.limit: Local to the frozen model, not a global identification classification.
entries.statement:
theorem observed_local_level_set (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    HasTwentyDimensionalLocalFiber alpha :=

entries.title: Exact Jacobian rank and nullity
entries.summary: The parameter-to-observation map has a 20-dimensional Jacobian kernel at the designated model point.
entries.limit: Specific 31-parameter, 11-output map, not arbitrary measurement systems.
entries.statement:
theorem jacobian_nullity (alpha : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (jacobian (frozen alpha 5)).toLinearMap) = 20 :=

entries.title: Infinitely many curvature closures
entries.summary: Constructs infinitely many distinct smooth regularized curvature closures satisfying the stipulated admissibility conditions.
entries.limit: Nonuniqueness for the frozen axioms, not a classification of every closure.
entries.statement:
theorem infinitely_many_distinct_closures (ε α S : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hS : 0 < S) :
    Set.Infinite (Set.range
      (fun k : ℕ => (fun p : ℂ × ℂ =>
        curvature ε α (k : ℝ) S p.1 p.2))) :=
